title: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Microsoft 365): Accounting skills
summary: Streamline corporate accounting work New accounting capabilities in Excel and Cowork help accountants spend less time on repetitive, manual tasks in the places they already work, including: • Reconcile accounts with confidence: Compare balances and transactions, identify discrepancies, and prepare reconciling items for review. • Prepare journal entries faster: Draft accruals, reclassifications, allocations, reversals, and recurring entries, with checks for required inputs and balanced entries. •
